_documentation: Accounts a news item may tag in its LinkedIn and Bluesky posts, written @Key in the post text (the key, any case). linkedin: the page's name as LinkedIn shows it and its organisation URN (urn:li:organization:<number>, from the page admin's URL). bluesky: the handle, without @. A null value posts the tag as the plain name on that network. scripts/social-post.py turns each tag into a LinkedIn mention and a Bluesky mention, and news-from-issue.py refuses a tag that is not listed here. The EISS repository keeps the same file.
